text:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the design review — noticed a few docs <-> console mismatches that we should tidy before the rollout. Short list below, and a few UX nits for the in-product help panel.

sasha: 1) Terminology: console shows `Model revision` but public docs (and API examples) use `model version`. Pick one surface term and update cross-links.

sasha: 2) Routes vs Endpoints: the Console labels them "Routes" in the sidebar but the docs call them "Endpoints". This confuses support and customers during onboarding.

sasha: 3) Dedicated vs Reserved: sometimes we say "Dedicated pool" and other times "Reserved capacity". Suggest we standardize to `Dedicated (Reserved capacity)` in UI copy and add the canonical term in docs metadata.

sasha: 4) In-product docs panel: we currently iframe the docs page but there are no anchors or a visible docs version. Need: anchorable headings, a small header with `Docs vX.Y` and a direct "Open in docs" link that opens the canonical page (so folks can share).

sasha: 5) Accessibility: the help panel trap focus and keyboard users can't close it with `Esc` consistently. Also code blocks inside the panel lack a copy button.

evan: +1 on all. For (1) I prefer `model version` (matches API).

liam: For anchors — engineering can we add stable fragment IDs to <h2> in the docs HTML? That way `#model-version` will work.

matt: @liam yes, we can add IDs; will need a small docs-tooling PR. Also can emit a canonical link meta tag for sharing.

rachel: Copy suggestion for console tooltip (quick draft): `Model version — the specific weights and config used for inference. See docs` -> link. I'm happy to open a docs PR with the wording.

sasha: Nice — for copy please use inline code style for the console labels (e.g., `Model version`) so it's consistent with other UI calls.

rachel: I'll draft the PR tonight. Quick example of the link pattern I plan to use:```https://docs.redwood.ai/console/models#model-version```

docs-bot: Automated check: docs page /console/models currently references `model revision` in 2 places (v1.3). See https://docs.redwood.ai/console/models#diff-issues

evan: docs-bot — can we add a rule to flag mismatched label strings between UI text and docs? That would be super helpful during releases.

docs-bot: Feature request noted. Will schedule a lint rule in the docs pipeline — low priority tag added.

liam: UX nit: when opening the in-product docs panel, we should highlight (briefly) the relevant heading (e.g., `Model version`) so users see the context. That plus `Open in docs` will reduce confusion.

matt: Also, telemetry ask: add event `console.help_opened` with a `docs_slug` property so we can track which doc pages people open from the console. Ops/analytics, is that ok?

evan: SGTM. analytics: we'll add `console_help_open` and `help_panel_source` props to the schema.

rachel: For the accessibility Esc behavior — I can add an a11y test case to the component-level tests. Will pair with eng on how focus is returned to the trigger.

sasha: Nice. Owners: rachel -> copy + docs PR, liam & matt -> docs anchors + canonical link + telemetry, evan -> analytics schema, liam -> small eng change to add `Esc` close and copy button inside code blocks.

matt: I'll create the engineering ticket and PR template. PR will include screenshots and a short accessibility checklist.

rachel: I'll ping here when PR is up.

evan: Quick question — do we want the console to display the docs commit SHA or just semver? I lean semver plus a hover with the SHA.

sasha: Semver on surface, SHA in hover/expanded meta. Good compromise.

liam: Will we need a docs build step to emit the semver into the HTML? If so, we should add that to the release checklist.

matt: yep — docs CI can inject a `data-docs-version` attribute during build. I'll note it in the ticket.

rachel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 (copy + Add `Model version` canonicalization). PTAL.

sasha: Thanks! I'll follow up in the design review doc with the finalized label list.

liam: quick ack :thumbsup:

matt: noted, will start a docs-tooling PR next sprint and link it here.

docs-bot: Reminder: next docs sync is Thu 09:30.

sasha: Great thread. Small wins — helps reduce onboarding confusion. :white_check_mark:
